agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix ddee520d8c12 on top of intro 9a6e62563c9b via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The introducing commit (9a6e625, fixing bug 424205788) refactored the dead-value handling for effectful nodes in the LOWER phase. The old approach called DisconnectFromEffectAndControl(node) followed by conversion to DeadValue. The new approach set is_dead=true, set feedback_type to None, called InsertUnreachableIfNecessary (which only patches the effect chain but doesn't replace the node itself), then returned early. This is incorrect for effectful nodes with control inputs: the node remains in the graph as its original operation but with a None type, violating the invariant that all nodes in the lowered graph must be either properly typed or replaced by appropriate dead-code nodes.
